'''Vondoru''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Battle of Vondoru|ambushed]] the [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] ''[[Intercessor]]'' over Vondoru and [[Battle of Vondoru|destroyed]] it.<ref name="TOR" />
